sentences.text: Shri Aman Dubey - Advocate for applicant.
Ms. Seema Sahu - Panel Lawyer for the State.
Ms. Sikha Baghel - Advocate for objector.

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 315/2024 dated 21.6.2024 registered at Police Station, Lordganj District Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 376-D, 386 and 506 of the IPC and sections 3/4, 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act.

The previous application was dismissed on 09-08-2024.
2.

The counsel for the applicant contends that earlier on two occasions time was granted to the State to seek instructions as regards video clipping which according to the complainant's statement recorded under Section 164 of the CrPC was made by the present applicant.

The counsel contends that apparently, no video clipping was found in the mobile of the present applicant nor the same was forwarded to anyone, therefore, the applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55737 2 MCRC-42409-2024 deserves to be enlarged on bail.

3. Per contra, the counsel for the State as well as objector have opposed the application and submitted that the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of CrPC on 24-06-2024 clearly reflects that the present applicant had made a video when the offence of rape was being committed upon the victim and this fact was brought to the notice of the victim by the co-accused,

sentences.text: Mohd. Hamid Mansoori on snap chat.
4 . Having considered the submissions, perusal of the record reflects that previous bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 09-08- 2024.
This Court while dismissing the application has taken into consideration the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the CrPC on 24-06-2024.
Apparently, there is no changed circumstance as of now, therefore, this Court is not inclined to entertain this application.
However, the applicant is at liberty to revive the prayer after examination of the prosecution witnesses.
(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE ac Aayush Jha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70615080/
